canonical_name: South Gyle Green Data Centre (1 Redheughs Avenue, Edinburgh)

aliases.alias: Former RBS headquarters / Drummond House site
Proposed Green Data Centre and Relocation of Green Space

summary: Proposed c. 212.4 MW hyperscale 'green' data centre by Shelborn Drummond Ltd (Shelborn Asset Management group) on the 5.74 ha former RBS headquarters site at 1 Redheughs Avenue, South Gyle/Edinburgh Park, Edinburgh. Planning permission in principle (25/04239/PPP) for a two-building campus with dedicated substation, standby generator compounds and a relocated public park was recommended for approval by officers but refused unanimously by City of Edinburgh Council's Development Management Sub-Committee on 4 February 2026 (decision notice 9 February 2026), on grounds including conflict with NPF4 Policies 1 and 2 and City Plan 2030 Place 19. Shelborn appealed; the appeal (DPEA ref PPA-230-2794, received 31 March 2026) is proceeding by written submissions and is with a reporter, target date 18 August 2026. This is the highest-profile Scottish data centre refusal case to date.
maturity_explanation: Formal application for planning permission in principle 25/04239/PPP (dated 18 August 2025, per DPEA) was validated and determined: refused by City of Edinburgh Council on 9 February 2026 following the committee's unanimous vote on 4 February 2026 against officer recommendation. Appeal PPA-230-2794 received by DPEA 31 March 2026 and allocated to a reporter (written submissions), so the project remains a live formal application under appeal rather than a lapsed scheme.
